text_block_list.text:
"—Walpurgis Night (Hexennacht). The 
festival Zenno Rob Roy called such, the 
'Japan Cup', has come to an end."

Manhattan Cafe put on an impressive 
performance worthy of the world stage—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Cafe-san... Good work out 
there...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
We were talking about it before, weren't 
we? The story about the wicked witch.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy-san... Yes...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yet the way you ran today... didn't look 
cursed at all. It was so dazzling...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"If something is guiding me, I think... it 
must be a good witch."

"There was still much left unexplained. 
Even so, after the race, no misfortune 
befell Manhattan Cafe."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, um...!

After the race, despite her excellent 
result, Manhattan Cafe rushed over, 
looking pale as a ghost. And then—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Over here. My "friend" said it's this 
way...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"There's something... here. Something that 
wasn't here before. Something that 
shouldn't be here."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: So—!
The place I was led to was...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "This place... looks familiar..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That day, a year and a half ago... a 
single Umamusume... a golden gear dazzling 
even from afar...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The spot where she stopped on her own. I 
don't know the reason. But—
(Screeeeeeech...!)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: This... sound is...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hello, Cafe. And Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"An 'eternal farewell'— kukuku, what an 
unreliable cliché."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Tachyon-san...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, since you've come all this way, you 
may watch from over there."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Every single detail of my press 
conference, that is.

In the blink of an eye, the venue became a 
swirling sea of people.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
To all who have gathered—lend me your 
ears.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I, Agnes Tachyon, shall resume my racing 
career at the upcoming Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: OOOOOOOH!?

The announcement came just as abruptly as 
the indefinite hiatus had.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Agnes Tachyon-san! Retiring, then running 
again... just what is your reason for all 
this?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, you know, all sorts of reasons. 
Circumstances are always complicated.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
There are things I cannot speak of due to 
their complexity, but there are also 
things I can simply state with certainty.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
At the Arima Kinen, I will— compete 
against Manhattan Cafe right here for the 
title of Grand Prix champion!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Staking everything I have. That concludes 
my presentation.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

I nodded silently. There was no running 
away. And then—

A shudder ran down my spine. Just how on 
earth did things turn out this way...?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon-san, please talk to me a little 
more!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Talk? We already did. I will run. I gave 
my word, and I am capable. That is all!

Reporters chase after the departing Agnes 
Tachyon.

The Arima Kinen. Yesterday's friends now 
stand as today's fated rivals.
